product_updates.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
product_updates.content: The neolab is betting that automating routine computer tasks will soon outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.

product_updates.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
product_updates.content: The acquisition brings Poke’s conversational style and interaction model to Cognition’s coding agent Devin, reflecting a growing belief that how AI assistants interact with users is as important as the models powering them.

product_updates.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
product_updates.content: Opus 5 will be both cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, likely making it preferable in most use cases.

product_updates.title: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
product_updates.content: AI companies, including Nvidia and Mistral, urge policymakers to avoid broad restrictions on open-weight AI models as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI and alleged model distillation.

product_updates.title: Bluesky’s AI assistant Attie expands into an open social research tool
product_updates.content: Users can now ask Attie questions about news, trends, and conversations on Bluesky and other apps on the AT Protocol.

product_updates.title: Midjourney acquired the astrology app Co-Star
product_updates.content: The AI lab Midjourney continues to expand its purview beyond image and video generation.

product_updates.title: OpenAI’s new voice mode makes it to the ChatGPT desktop app
product_updates.content: ChatGPT Voice on desktop can work with both ChatGPT Work and Codex to complete tasks and control agents.

product_updates.title: How AI guardrails are impeding the work of offensive cybersecurity researchers
product_updates.content: We spoke with several cybersecurity researchers, who look for unknown vulnerabilities and develop tools to exploit them, about how OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s guardrails affect their work.
